title: 897. Smallest Range I

examples.explanation: Only one element exists, so the score is 0 however it is shifted.
Move 0 up to 2 and 10 down to 8; the spread becomes 8 - 2 = 6, which is the best possible.
Shift every value to 4 (1 + 3, 3 + 1, 6 - 2); all equal, so the score is 0.
